close_reason: Obsoleted by JMAP-h47t.10: the .cloned() in recompute_task_lists_with_tasks was a workaround for the borrow-checker collision in a function that itself is now deleted. The new incremental refcount path does not have a similar shape — inc/dec_task_ref each acquire aux_mut for a single insert/decrement without holding an outer immutable borrow on self.objects.
title: MemoryBackend::recompute_task_lists_with_tasks clones entire Task HashMap to escape borrow checker
